# 2. Figure 2C -- Heatmap
```{r}
df <- fread("/Users/wchen20/Desktop/2026-02-16_Draft/Revision/R1Major2/005/Summary/MutationsFreq/260406/oncoMSS_PCAWG.csv") %>% 
  mutate(pathway_new = gsub("\n", "", pathway_new)) %>% 
  mutate(pathway_new = case_when(pathway_new == "Antigen Presentation via MHC-I" & cell_type == "MHCregulators" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (MHC-I) "),
                                 pathway_new == "Antigen Presentation via MHC-I" & cell_type == "Tcells" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (Tcells) "),
                                 pathway_new == "Antigen Processing and Presentation" & cell_type == "NKcells" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (NKcells) "),
                                 pathway_new == "IFNg Signaling" & cell_type == "NKcells" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (NKcells) "),
                                 pathway_new == "IFNg Signaling" & cell_type == "MHCregulators" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (MHC-I)"),
                                 pathway_new == "IFNg Signaling" & cell_type == "Tcells" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (Tcells)"),
                                 pathway_new == "Necroptosis" & cell_type == "Tcells" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (Tcells)"),
                                 pathway_new == "Necroptosis" & cell_type == "NKcells" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (NKcells)"),
                                 pathway_new == "Regulation of Autophagy" & cell_type == "MHCregulators" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (MHC-I)"),
                                 pathway_new == "Autophagy" & cell_type == "Tcells" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (Tcells)"),
                                 pathway_new == "HSWI SNF pathway_new" ~ "SWI/SNF pathway_new",
                                 pathway_new == "TNF Pathway" & cell_type == "Tcells" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (Tcells)"),
                                 pathway_new == "TNF Pathway" & cell_type == "NKcells" ~ paste0(pathway_new, " (NKcells)"),
                                 TRUE ~ pathway_new)) %>% filter(Sum > 5)

order_type = df %>% arrange(histology_abbreviation) %>% pull(histology_abbreviation) %>% unique()
order_all = c(order_type, "All")
  
df_all <- df %>% distinct(pathway_new, cell_type, regulator, percent_whole) %>% 
  mutate(histology_abbreviation = "All",
         percent_mut = percent_whole)

df_plot <- rbind(df, df_all, fill = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(percent_mut)) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_mut   = as.numeric(percent_mut),
    percent_whole = as.numeric(percent_whole),

    # X: alphabetical
    histology_abbreviation = factor(
      histology_abbreviation,
      levels = order_all),

    # Y: order pathways by max percent_whole (desc), then flip so highest at top
    pathway_new = fct_rev(
      fct_reorder(pathway_new, percent_whole, .fun = max, .desc = TRUE)
    )
  )

y_labels <- df_plot %>%
  distinct(pathway_new, cell_type) %>%
  mutate(
    label_col = case_when(
      cell_type == "MHCregulators"   ~ "#1E90FF",
      cell_type == "Tcells"          ~ "#00CD66",
      cell_type == "NKcells"         ~ "#191970",
      cell_type == "Macrophages"     ~ "orange",
      cell_type == "GammadeltaTcells"~ "#008B8B",
      TRUE ~ "black"
    ),
    pathway_colored = paste0("<span style='color:", label_col, "'>", pathway_new, "</span>")
  )

label_lookup <- setNames(y_labels$pathway_colored, y_labels$pathway_new)

heatmap_plot <- df_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = histology_abbreviation, y = pathway_new, fill = percent_mut)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("white", "#8E24AA", "#4A148C"),
    name = "Frequency",
    breaks = c(0, 0.15, 0.45),
    labels = c("0%", "15%", "45%")
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_lookup) +   # 👈 apply colored labels
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(hjust = 1, size = 16),  # 👈 enable HTML labels
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(path_figure, "Figure2C1.pdf"),
  plot = heatmap_plot,
  width = 15,
  height = 12)

# color mapping for cell types
cell_colors <- c(
  "MHC-I regulation"   = "#1E90FF",
  "T-cell killing"     = "#00CD66",
  "NK-cell killing"    = "#191970",
  "Macrophage killing" = "orange",
  "gdT-cell killing"   = "#008B8B"
)

# Desired order (top-to-bottom in legend)
cell_order <- c("MHC-I regulation", 
                "T-cell killing", 
                "NK-cell killing", 
                "Macrophage killing", 
                "gdT-cell killing")

legend_df <- data.frame(cell_type = factor(names(cell_colors), levels = cell_order))

legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = 1, y = cell_type, color = cell_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_colors, name = "Cell type", breaks = cell_order) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

legend_plot

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(path_figure, "Figure2C2.pdf"),
  plot = legend_plot,
  width = 3,
  height = 3)
```
